name: d_pellet_mm
source: Spec default; van Kampen et al. (2021) measured 1.6 mm pellets

name: eta_screw
source: Screw-feeder volumetric efficiency (Bortolamasi & Fottner 2001); range 0.5-1.0 not measured

name: q_in_kgkg
source: Interface contract: q = 0 on the Sips working-capacity scale (PSA to 1-3 bar(a) + dry inert purge at the same T, as in van Kampen RCE 2021). Positive values = regeneration less complete than in the paper (sensitivity only)

name: T_zeolite_in_C
source: Spec (21 Nov): 200-250 C, default 200 C = lower edge of the Sips data

name: T_gas_in_C
source: ASSUMPTION: gas enters the core at reactor temperature (reactor 250-275 C)

name: p_bar
source: Spec default (40 bar = proposal value, run as an extrapolated comparison)

name: p_tested_max_bar
source: van Kampen tested the sorbent at 5-30 bar; above this the result is an extrapolation

name: m_zeolite_kgh
source: Check-mode default only; design mode finds the lowest rate with bed T <= 250 C (about 2.2 t/h at a 200 C feed)

name: X_conv
source: Spec: CO2 conversion per pass, near the direct-DME benchmark (~26.5%)

name: S_dme
source: Spec: carbon to DME per pass, rest to CO by RWGS (benchmark DME selectivity ~69%)

name: basis_tCO2_day
source: Spec basis (fresh CO2 with recycle)

name: D_m
source: Check-mode default: casing ID = screw flight diameter

name: H_m
source: Check-mode default: bed height

name: d_shaft_ratio
source: Screw shaft diameter / D (design mode)

name: pitch_ratio
source: Screw pitch / D (standard full pitch)

name: U_wall_Wm2K
source: 0 = adiabatic core (spec hand calc); >0 = heat loss to surrounding bed

name: T_wall_C
source: Temperature on the other side of the core wall

name: capture_min
source: Spec criterion: water captured >= 95%

name: lift_max_ratio
source: Spec criterion: gas drag <= 70% of bed weight (assumed margin)

name: dp_max_bar
source: Spec criterion: core pressure drop <= 1 bar

name: T_bed_max_C
source: Spec criterion: bed temperature <= 250 C (data range of the Sips isotherm)

name: HD_min
source: 5th design criterion (team decision 21 Nov 2026): H/D >= 2 so the moving bed flows evenly; assumed rule of thumb, no specific source

name: T_min_C
source: Validity range of Part 1 isotherm/LDF data

name: T_max_C
source: Validity range of Part 1 isotherm/LDF data

name: pH2O_min_bar
source: Validity range of Part 1 isotherm/LDF data

name: pH2O_max_bar
source: Validity range of Part 1 isotherm/LDF data

name: E_iso_shift_Jmol
source: |Ea| of Sips b(T) (van Kampen 2021, RCE 6:244); used ONLY to extrapolate q* outside 200-350 C

name: Ea_kldf_Jmol
source: Micropore diffusion Ea (van Kampen 2021, Adsorption 27:577, Table 5); used ONLY to extrapolate k_LDF outside 200-350 C

name: n_steps
source: Height steps of the marching for-loop

name: pinch_tol
source: |W_gas - W_solid| / max(W) below this -> ThermalPinchError (near-balanced cases are very stiff and perform badly anyway)

name: table_dT_K
source: Lookup-table step in T for q* and k_LDF (property_tables.py). Real Part 1 k_LDF: 2 K gave 4.4e-4, 0.5 K gives 2.6e-5 (check_tables.py, 21 Nov 2026)

name: table_dlnp
source: Lookup-table step in ln(pH2O) for q* and k_LDF; with dT 0.5 K: error < 1e-4 against Part 1 (test_core.py)

name: k_ldf_factor_recommended
source: Recommended size: all criteria with k_LDF x 0.5. k_LDF halved: the model matches van Kampen 2021 Fig. 9 only within a factor of ~2 and ignores macropore resistance of 3 mm pellets (assumption)
